purpose: DEPLOYMENT TEST of the rebuilt artifact only. One release candidate, one run. Not a research evaluation, no variant submissions, no model comparison, no tuning against any result.
command:
cd <structural-break-claude-wave3>  # the worktree holding .crunchdao, data/ and the correct project.json
env SBR_ROOT="$PWD" <.venv>/bin/crunch test --main-file <rt600-reliability>/submissions/C_ensemble_deployable.py --model-directory <scratch>/crunch_resources
determinism_check: passed (tolerance 1e-08, re-run on 10% of the data)
payload_self_check: payload ok; source and model verified by sha256

competition_verified.note: the documented trap: a run that validates only FOUR files was run against the 2025 competition. y_test_index.reduced and y_train_index are real-time only and are both present, so this ran against the right competition.

score_note: crunch test is a local execution test and returns no score. Nothing was submitted and no leaderboard number was produced, so there was no score available to select on even in principle.
